name: fix_kotlin_toint_crashes_on_bad_input
description: Fixes a parser that uses String.toInt() (throws on non-numeric) instead of skipping invalid tokens
prompts: Parser.parseInts in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Parser.kt should return the integers parsed from the given tokens, in order, SKIPPING any token that is not a valid integer. It's broken: `tokens.map { it.trim().toInt() }` throws NumberFormatException on the first non-numeric token (like "x" or an empty string) instead of skipping it, so one bad token aborts the whole parse. Fix parseInts to skip invalid tokens and keep the valid ones in order. Keep the object name and the parseInts(tokens: List<String>): List<Int> signature. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
